Become a channel member https://www.youtube.com/makedogrow/join
Become a club member https://www.makedogrow.com/club
Download plans of the house and land https://www.makedogrow.com/super-fan-pack

It's early September and things are starting to wind down in the garden after the hot summer. But we've still got tons of produce to harvest, process and preserve. In this episode we're focusing on peppers and will show you how we make pasta sauce, roast pepper pesto and other culinary delights. 

We'll also show you one of our favourite ways to preserve fruit – by turning it into booze! We'll start two batches of fruit wine (also known as country wine) as well as highlight some of our past successes and not so successes in the hobby of home brewing.

Wine tasting with my sister https://youtu.be/rz25kCXGASw
Making courgette wine https://youtu.be/2bDrwyqLqEs
Why do we grow so much food https://youtu.be/LW3uVxk3CXE
metadata.title: 葡萄牙田园生活：辣椒大丰收，自酿果酒｜Preserving a TON of Peppers and Making Country Wine
